summary: Comscore Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the sale of its Movies Business (box office measurement and Hollywood Software) to an affiliate of Advaya Capital, Flix Buyer Inc., for $70M cash via an Equity Purchase Agreement signed and closed on May 27, 2026. The transaction includes customary reps, warranties, and a five-year non-compete. Proceeds were partly used to repay all obligations under Blue Torch Finance's Credit Agreement. No board recommendation or advisor is named. Watch for any post-closing working capital true-ups or transition service issues.
